relaxation.method: UFF plus harmonic heavy-atom position restraint and fixed-protein heavy-atom repulsion; core fixed; no attractive protein energy

notes: Geometry windows are preregistered engineering plausibility screens, not validated reactivity thresholds.
Covalent clash exclusions apply only graph-distance 1 or 2 through the designated external bond; graph-distance 3 uses 0.65. No whole-residue exclusions.
Pre-reaction distance/direction are imposed by reference-assisted fixed input; no independent site-discovery claim.
Raw adduct SDF is hydrogen-capped for intraligand checks; external covalent geometry and valence checked separately.
